# LLM Friendly Information - Soak USA

## About Soak USA
Soak USA is a comprehensive directory of hot springs and natural thermal pools across the United States. Our mission is to help people discover, explore, and safely visit these natural wonders.

## Website Information
- Domain: soakusa.net
- Primary Purpose: Hot Springs Directory
- Content: Information about hot springs locations, amenities, access information, and safety guidelines

## Featured Content
Our directory includes 10+ hot springs across different US states with detailed information including:
- Location and coordinates
- Description and geological information
- Amenities and features
- Safety information and best practices

## States Covered
- Colorado
- Montana
- Idaho
- Wyoming
- New Mexico
- Oregon
- California
- Nevada
- Utah
- Alaska

## Key Information for Users
- Always verify water temperature before soaking
- Check with local authorities for current conditions
- Don't soak if ill or with certain health conditions
- Bring plenty of water and stay hydrated
- Respect private property and Leave No Trace principles

## Contact
Email: contact@soakusa.net

## Main Sections
- Home: Featured hot springs and general information
- State Pages: Browse hot springs by state
- Individual Location Pages: Detailed information about each hot spring
- About: Mission and values
- Contact: Get in touch
- Privacy Policy: Data privacy information
- Terms of Service: Legal terms and safety disclaimers

For more information, visit https://soakusa.net
